entries.title: Saint George and the dragon, Reguliersgracht 34
entries.reason: forging story needs a second source; private house
entries.hook: The relief's twelve faces are the twelve Jews hidden in this house; "I dive under to come up".

entries.title: Poentunnel, the bankers' tunnel under the Keizersgracht, and the Vijzelbank
entries.reason: nothing to see of the tunnel from the street
entries.hook: The only tunnel under a canal, dug so bank directors walked dry; the bank over the Kerkstraat caused a council storm.

entries.title: The krullen, Amsterdam's open-air urinals
entries.reason: three scouts proposed a krul (CW-04 Westermarkt, DC-40 Oudekerksplein): one pin, or one per zone
entries.hook: See-through iron urinals so police could count the men inside; Dolle Mina tied them shut in 1970.

entries.title: Four views of Den Helder, Kerkstraat 402-408
entries.hook: Four stones of 1672 show the coast a carpenter came from: Huisduinen, Den Helder, Nieuwe Diep, Wieringen.

entries.title: Orphan gable tops: the gables that played musical chairs
entries.reason: jordaan-5 draft has Rozenstraat 35-43: link or merge
entries.hook: About 135 canal houses wear tops taken from demolished houses; Prinsengracht 755's sea gods came from the Amstelstraat.

entries.title: Herengracht 412, perhaps the oldest garden house
entries.reason: private; garden houses were dropped at review as invisible from the street
entries.hook: A garden house crowned in 1734 whose core may still be 17th-century.

entries.title: Where Stichting 1940-1945 was founded, Keizersgracht 567
entries.hook: The resistance groups met here in secret in October 1944 to found their mutual-aid foundation.

entries.title: Herengracht 524, Jurriaan Andriessen's painted landscape room
entries.hook: Behind a neck gable, a whole room painted as a landscape in 1771.

entries.title: Hans Brinker Budget Hotel, proudly the worst
entries.hook: A hostel famous for advertising itself as the worst: guests leave in worse shape.

entries.title: Halvemaansteeg 4-6, the illegal demolition
entries.hook: An owner demolished listed houses without a permit in 2014; the gap is still there.

entries.title: Koningsplein 10, the 3-metre chocolate shop
entries.hook: An Art Nouveau front under three metres wide, built for a chocolatier in 1901 and rebuilt after a 1936 fire.
